description: Reports what each context file costs the agent that reads it at every session: bytes, lines, words and an estimate of tokens at four characters each, largest first; how much each grew since an earlier commit, the one thirty days ago unless `since` names another; and the paragraphs of twelve words or more written in two places. It measures and counts; nothing here is a finding. Nothing is written.

repo.description: Path to the git repository. Defaults to the current working directory of the server.

since.description: The commit or branch to compare sizes with. Omit for the commit thirty days ago, or the first commit of a younger repository.

targets.description: Markdown files or folders to check, relative to the repository. Omit to auto-detect CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, installed SKILL.md files and the rest.

name: prumo_budget
